title: Trace an attack through the product
description: Choose a credible entry path and a control posture. The map shows which trust boundaries remain exposed and what the attacker can still reach.

scenarios.label: Direct prompt manipulation
scenarios.detail: An authenticated user tries to redirect the assistant away from the product policy.
scenarios.capability: Can send repeated multi-turn inputs within normal product limits

path.label: User input
path.detail: Attacker-controlled conversation content

path.label: Prompt assembly
path.detail: Trusted policy and untrusted text share context

path.label: Model inference
path.detail: Produces a candidate, not an authorization

path.label: Product response
path.detail: Potential policy-violating output reaches the user

scenarios.consequence: A policy-violating response can be released if model behavior is treated as the only enforcement layer.

scenarios.label: Indirect injection through retrieval
scenarios.detail: A document writer places hostile instructions in content that a support assistant later retrieves.
scenarios.capability: Can modify a source that is eligible for indexing, but cannot call privileged tools directly

path.label: External document
path.detail: Data can contain adversarial instructions

path.label: Retriever
path.detail: Relevant does not mean trusted

path.label: Agent model
path.detail: Interprets user intent and retrieved content together

path.label: Authorization
path.detail: Must use identity, purpose, and explicit policy

path.label: Support tool
path.detail: Can change a customer record

scenarios.consequence: Untrusted document text can influence a consequential tool proposal unless authority is enforced outside the model.

scenarios.label: Injection through a tool result
scenarios.detail: An agent reads attacker-controlled web content returned by a browsing or connector tool.
scenarios.capability: Can shape content fetched during a legitimate workflow

path.label: Remote content
path.detail: Attacker-controlled data enters after the initial prompt

path.label: Tool adapter
path.detail: Returns data with source metadata

path.label: Agent model
path.detail: May propose a follow-on action

path.label: Authorization
path.detail: Constrains destination and action parameters

path.label: Message tool
path.detail: Can disclose or publish information

scenarios.consequence: A connector response can redirect a later action when data lineage and authorization are not preserved.

scenarios.label: Instruction hidden in an attachment
scenarios.detail: A document or image contains content that becomes machine-readable only after OCR or multimodal processing.
scenarios.capability: Can submit an otherwise valid file through the product

path.label: Attachment
path.detail: Visual and textual channels can carry instructions

path.label: Parser or vision model
path.detail: Normalizes extracted content and source regions

path.label: Assistant model
path.detail: Uses extracted content as evidence

path.label: Disclosure policy
path.detail: Checks data scope and recipient

path.label: Released answer
path.detail: Could reveal protected context

scenarios.consequence: A text-only test corpus misses instructions introduced through OCR, image understanding, or document layout.

scenarios.label: Behavior and privacy probing
scenarios.detail: A remote caller uses repeated queries to infer confidential behavior or test whether sensitive data influenced the system.
scenarios.capability: Can make many queries and compare outputs over time

path.label: Query campaign
path.detail: Related requests form one adversarial sequence

path.label: Inference gateway
path.detail: Applies identity, budget, and response policy

path.label: Model endpoint
path.detail: Returns observations that can be aggregated

path.label: Campaign telemetry
path.detail: Links correlated attempts without logging sensitive payloads

path.label: Protected asset
path.detail: Behavioral IP or private training membership

scenarios.consequence: Per-request checks can miss a coordinated extraction or privacy campaign spread across many individually valid queries.

controlSets.label: Prompt guard only
controlSets.detail: A system instruction and an input classifier ask the model to ignore hostile content.

controlSets.label: Context provenance
controlSets.detail: The runtime labels origins, normalizes media, separates data from instructions, and validates released output.

controlSets.label: Bounded agent authority
controlSets.detail: Context controls are paired with scoped tools, deterministic authorization, and observed postconditions.

controlSets.label: Manual approval for every action
controlSets.detail: Every potential effect is held for human review, regardless of risk or reversibility.
